scope.excluded: the 2026-09-28 experiments, whose raw bodies are in a separate directory

evidence_classes.OBSERVED: value literally present in a saved provider response body or balance response
evidence_classes.DERIVED: arithmetic over OBSERVED values and the published rate table
evidence_classes.ASSUMED: premise not established by this campaign
evidence_classes.NOT_OBSERVED: evidence never captured; never read as zero or false

DERIVED.formula: fresh/1e6*miss_rate + cache_read/1e6*hit_rate + out/1e6*out_rate, rates chosen by model and by the call's own timestamp

evidence_gaps.gap: reasoning_tokens absent on 306 of 479 responses; only 173 carry completion_tokens_details
evidence_gaps.impact: reconstruct.py adds zero for the other 306, promoting NOT_OBSERVED to zero in the reasoning total; cost unaffected because reasoning is a subset of completion_tokens

evidence_gaps.gap: cache_creation_input_tokens present and 0 on both anthropic responses; field absent entirely on the 477 chat responses
evidence_gaps.impact: pricing.cost_usd has no cache-creation argument, so a non-zero cache write would be silently unpriced; it is zero here

evidence_gaps.gap: the 2 anthropic-dialect responses carry no created field
evidence_gaps.impact: reconstruct.py substitutes the corpus's latest timestamp; both calls are peak either way so cost is unchanged, but the substitution would misprice a run crossing 04:00 UTC

evidence_gaps.gap: pricing.is_peak does not model Chinese public holidays
evidence_gaps.impact: if 2026-09-29 were a holiday every call is off-peak and the total halves to about $0.1150, which falls far outside the B3 observed interval

B2.procedure: structural check on req/res pairing, census against EXPERIMENT-LEDGER.md, and a repository search
B2.structural_argument: adapter.Adapter._post writes req-<id>.json before dispatch and passes curl -o res-<id>.json, so a dispatched call that lost its response leaves an orphan request stem; zero orphans exist, so the harness path is complete

DS-RS_void_first_run.note: real spend, deliberately absent from the ledger n column

unsaved_calls.reason_unsaved: issued by raw curl without -o, so no file was written

lower_bounds.balance_path_note: needs no rate table; from the B3 resolution interval

would_require: the raw response bodies of the 5 DS-F2b calls, which were never written and cannot be recovered by reading
a provider-side per-request usage or billing record; the surface map enumerated eight endpoints and found none, and /user/balance returns an account total with no line items
acceptance of stated premises: if the rate table is exact and no non-campaign spend touched the account, the B3 interval puts the 5 unsaved calls strictly below 0.2400 - 0.229947 = 0.010053 USD

field_format.note: reconcile.py casts through float(), so numeric artifacts are not evidence of the wire format

display_semantics.why_it_does_not_matter: for a difference of two readings each error spans a half-open interval of width q in either semantics, so the difference interval is (D-q, D+q) either way

balance_poll.incompleteness_note: 5 rows over 8 minutes; the poller was still running when this track read the file; the file records a parsed float and not the raw body

DERIVED.derivation: T0 in [B0-e, B0-e+q), T1 in [B1-e, B1-e+q) for the same offset e under either semantics, so T0-T1 in (D-q, D+q)

correction_to_reconstruct_py.defect: applies a single reading's resolution to a difference of two readings, understating the interval by a factor of two, in the direction that flatters the reconciliation
correction_to_reconstruct_py.unrelated_fix_noted: another track rewrote this function during this run to compare in integer nano-USD, fixing a float boundary defect; that fix is correct and does not address the width

prior_comparison.note: reproduced exactly: cumulative derived at the $45.96 reading is 0.096008 and 46.01-45.96 = 0.05

settlement.now: closed; 99 minutes after the last call the balance gives 0.23 observed against 0.229947 derived
settlement.mechanism: settlement lag, not per-request cent truncation
settlement.effect_on_DS_F5: strengthened at session level and weakened in isolation; the $0.04 fall across the DS-F5 window cannot be attributed cleanly to that batch given ~$0.047 outstanding, but pricing the 3,744,384 cache reads at the miss rate would push the corpus to about $1.33, two orders of magnitude outside the observed interval

evidence_gaps.gap: the $46.01 session-start reading has no raw body on disk
evidence_gaps.impact: anchoring on the artifact-backed $46.00 instead gives (0.2100, 0.2300) and the lower bound 0.230054 falls just outside; $46.00 is not a valid anchor because it postdates $0.056917 of spend, but the margin is thin enough that the missing body matters

evidence_gaps.gap: sole occupancy of the account in the window
settlement completeness; evidenced by 5 identical reads over 8 minutes 91 minutes after the last call, not proven

B6.hypothesis: billed(request) = floor(100 * true_cost) / 100, so sub-cent calls bill as zero

arithmetic.comparison: 0.22 > 0.00, so the prediction fails by the entire session

B6.not_tested_by_this_evidence: truncation or rounding at a coarser granularity, for example per settlement batch or per billing period; distinguishing those needs a session whose derived total sits near a half-cent boundary with bracketing balance reads and confirmed settlement, repeated

proposed_corrections.defect: HALF_CENT_NANO = 5_000_000 gives [obs-0.005, obs+0.005) for a difference of two cent-resolution readings; correct is the open (obs-0.01, obs+0.01) from a full-cent constant
sums reasoning tokens as zero for the 306 responses that do not report them, promoting NOT_OBSERVED to zero
substitutes the corpus's latest timestamp for responses with no created field, a silent promotion that would misprice a run crossing a regime boundary
cost_usd has no cache-creation argument, so that priced quantity cannot be expressed; it is zero in this corpus
records the session-level reconciliation as OPEN at a factor of 1.9; it is closed at the B3 interval and the mechanism was settlement lag
balance reads do not persist the raw response body; the session-start $46.01 reading survives only as a transcribed number

concurrency_note: this worktree was shared with other tracks during the run; experiment/harness/{adapter,meter,reconstruct,session}.py were modified by another track while Track B was reading them, and experiment/harness/track_b_audit.py was committed by another track's git add
